narr: Isolated strong thunderstorms developed late in the day and into the evening across parts of northern El Paso County. Heavy rain with localized flooding were the main hazards, especially on the east side of Colorado Springs and near the Palmer Divide.
ev: Peyton Highway flooded five miles north of Peyton.
Intersection of Meridian and Londonderry flooded 6-8 inches deep.
Wooten Road flooded just north of Platte Avenue.
lsr: PEYTON HWY FLOODED 5 MILES NORTH OF PEYTON REPORTED BY SOCIAL MEDIA.
INTERSECTION OF MERIDIAN AND LONDONDERRY FLOODED 6-8 INCHES DEEP.
WOOTEN RD FLOODED JUST NORTH OF PLATTE AVE.
